source: EventMate draft: adjustable defaults for planning a community event. Not reviewed by event professionals or any authority. Suggested roles are prompts to confirm, not requirements. Conditional items say who to check with and never state a rule.

conditional_items.title: Permission to use the space
conditional_items.check_with: the owner of the venue or premises (the venue, society or institution)

conditional_items.title: Whether any local permits are needed to hold the event
conditional_items.check_with: the local authority or the police station that handles event permissions in your area

conditional_items.title: Rules about loudspeakers, music and noise
conditional_items.check_with: the local authority and the venue

conditional_items.title: Whether selling food needs a licence
Rules about collecting or receiving money from the public
conditional_items.check_with: the local authority, or an accountant or lawyer if you are unsure

conditional_items.title: Any limit on how many people may attend
conditional_items.check_with: the venue and the local authority

conditional_items.title: Fire and safety sign-off for the setup
conditional_items.check_with: the venue and the local fire or safety authority

conditional_items.title: First-aid or medical cover
conditional_items.check_with: the venue and your own medical contacts

conditional_items.title: Whether event insurance is needed or expected
A weather backup for outdoor areas
Allergen information for the food on offer
